svg.title: Compose layering, baseline plus dev override
svg.desc: The baseline compose file for a service defines the release build target, env files, healthcheck, Traefik routing labels and networks. The dev override file re-targets the build at the development stage, bind-mounts the source for hot reload, masks node_modules with anonymous volumes, publishes the Vite HMR port and relaxes the healthcheck start period. Docker Compose merges the two files, and make dev brings up the merged result, reachable through the router.

p.small:
build target: runner
env_file: .env.secrets · .env.shared · .env.site
healthcheck: curl /api/health
labels: Host(mechcrate.localhost) → port 4321
networks: default + devmesh-traefik

div.style: color: rgb(66, 32, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.small:
build target: development
volumes: ../../apps/site:/app
masks /app/node_modules and /app/.astro
ports: 24678 (Vite HMR)
NODE_ENV=development
healthcheck start_period: 30s
